## Problem and symptoms

- The 1 Hz cloud strategy drives the 100 Hz local MPC, causing the arm to continuously vibrate and trajectory to be uneven.
- The arm continues to vibrate and the trajectory is uneven.

## Environment

- Cloud RTX 4090 running Pi0.5; 1 Hz strategy output; local 100 Hz MPC; round-trip link latency.

## Priority diagnostics

- Verify strategy/control frequency ratio, action chunk size, old target reuse method, end-to-end delay, and delay jitter.

## Possible causes

- Low-frequency strategy commands are interrupted or stopped between 100 Hz control cycles.
- MPC repeatedly tracks old targets, combined with network delay fluctuations, causing discontinuous correction.
